text: Divya Sundaram is a QA/Test Engineer at FinTech Innovators Pvt. Ltd., where she specializes in ensuring the reliability and compliance of financial systems through rigorous testing. Over the past two years, she has focused on API testing, playing a key role in validating payment gateway integrations and ensuring seamless data exchange between third-party services. Her work on integration testing has been critical in aligning backend systems with frontend interfaces, supporting the company’s expansion into new market segments. Divya’s technical versatility extends to Java and Python, which she uses to build reusable test scripts and automate repetitive validation tasks. She has also contributed to REST API design, refining endpoints to meet both functional and security requirements. Her expertise in Selenium and Playwright has enabled the development of scalable test frameworks, streamlining regression testing for high-traffic financial applications. Divya’s commitment to quality is evident in her approach to unit testing, where she prioritizes edge cases to preempt potential vulnerabilities. Beyond technical execution, she collaborates closely with cross-functional teams to align testing priorities with business goals, ensuring deliverables meet both technical and regulatory standards in the fintech space. Her ability to balance precision with adaptability makes her an integral part of the company’s quality assurance efforts.
